checks.criterion: Inventory only artifacts/build and artifacts/tmp without following symlinks, rechecking live attempt/process ownership and preserving active/latest verified builds, shared caches, unknown files, durable state and evidence.
checks.procedure: Inspect inventory source for approved-root confinement and lstat/no-follow traversal; independently inventory approved roots with lstat and no symlink traversal; read active attempts and observe process/listener ownership; verify existence and identity of protected runtime, caches, worktrees and durable evidence.

checks.criterion: Report truthful eligible/retained/deleted paths and bytes with deterministic retained evidence and devlog; no deletion without all ADR0002 conditions and an explicit coordinator allowlist.
checks.procedure: Pin report/script hashes, compare report retained roots and logical regular-file bytes against independently measured current state, account for live build drift; verify empty allowlist, absence of deletion operations and reported zero deleted/reclaimed bytes; verify scoped devlog and durable evidence.
